name: Yvette Farthing
summary: In Brill, Yvette Farthing shares the Gallows' End Tavern with her father, Coleman. She remembers a love that ended when the Scourge came to Lordaeron.

sections.title: Echoes of the Mills
sections.body: Before the Third War, Yvette loved Thurman Agamand, heir to the prosperous Agamand Mills. When the Scourge plague drew near, she and her father, Coleman, begged Thurman to leave the estate. He refused, bound to his family's legacy. Yvette and Thurman both died and rose into undeath. Yvette found a place among the free-willed Forsaken in Brill, but she did not know what had become of Thurman.

sections.title: A Final Farewell
sections.body: Before Agamand Mills fell, Thurman wrote Yvette an urgent letter of love. He told her of his brother Devlin's treachery and mourned his choice to stay. The Scourge intercepted the letter, and it lay lost among the ruins until adventurers recovered it. Reading Thurman's dying confession brings Yvette a brief, true despair from her mortal life. Then she forces herself back into cold detachment, bitter that past attachments have no place in the Forsaken's grim reality.

faq.answer: Yvette Farthing lives in Brill's Gallows' End Tavern. She is Coleman Farthing's daughter and lived in the farmlands of Tirisfal Glades before the Third War destroyed the kingdom.

faq.q: What is Yvette's connection to Agamand Mills?
faq.answer: Yvette loved Thurman Agamand. When the plague threatened the region, she tried to persuade him to flee with her, but he chose to stay and defend his family's estate.

faq.q: What happens when you deliver Thurman's letter to her?
faq.answer: Thurman's long-lost letter briefly crushes Yvette with sorrow at his final words of love and betrayal. She quickly hardens her manner and says that she is Forsaken now, and mortal sentiment is useless.
Yvette's father is Coleman Farthing, a Forsaken who also lives in Brill's Gallows' End Tavern. They fled together at first, but both eventually succumbed to the plague and became Forsaken.

angles.text: As an Undead, you may carry human memories of love even as undeath hardens the heart.
